introduced.event_name: NCC 1983 — planned ERA² and Logix Athena premiere
introduced.timeline_note: Planned premiere on the opening day of NCC, 16–19 May 1983; not a confirmed shipment date.

specification.status: Accepted planning baseline; production and electrical qualification pending.
specification.register_compatibility: Preserve documented ERAv1 R0–R15/CPSR, instruction semantics, data formats and calling conventions.
specification.execution_improvements: Faster common instructions and effective-address calculation; improved prefetch scheduling over ERAv1’s existing four-word prefetch buffer. Detailed instruction timings pending.
specification.external_cache_policy: Interface support target only; no external cache included in the Athena base BOM until selected. DMA coherency must be specified.
specification.faults: Precisely defined restartable faults for demand paging. ERAv1 already has Data Abort and Prefetch Abort; ERA² strengthens the restart contract rather than introducing aborts for the first time.
specification.floating_point: Optional external FPU interface; no integrated or bundled FPU promised.
specification.performance_target: Approximately 2–3× an 8 MHz ERAv1 system on suitable workloads; unmeasured objective, dependent on cache, clock and memory timing.
specification.compatibility: Documented ERAv1 user binaries retain an execution path. New privileged/MMU features require OS support; no socket, mainboard or unqualified peripheral compatibility implied.
open_design_items: Board memory timing and qualified speed bins
